acceptanceCriteria: Notes writing is an explicit mutation command, never part of a read command, and the pointer is a digest of a committed CEM.
Foreign notes and trailers are read as untrusted history, labelled and never treated as project authority.
Round-trip and interop fixtures pass in the interop gate.
body: Owner requested the 2026-09 state-of-the-art gap review items as part of Corvint 0.7.0 on 2026-09-22. This ticket records release intent, not delivery or promotion. Original Go implementation; extend the cited existing mechanisms and preserve the existing public wires. Before implementation is called complete, update the owning indexed spec with stable requirements, non-goals, failure modes, acceptance evidence and rollback, and finish normal CEM/OCM, independent review and mandatory gates. Current state: no code handles git notes or commit trailers. Add an explicit command that records a CEM pointer in a Corvint notes ref, reads the Git AI `refs/notes/ai` schema for interop, and resolves `Assisted-by` and `Agent-Logs-Url` trailers as evidence with their own trust class. Owning spec: docs/specs/falsifiable-packet-v0.md.
title: proof: Git-native CEM anchoring via notes ref and trailer resolution
